verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents its own ways to extend the agent with specialized capabilities. You can add custom tools to its tool set without replacing the built-ins, override its subagents, and supply MCP server configs, which together let a developer equip it for specialized tasks. However, nothing in the evidence describes a skills mechanism as such (e.g. packaged skill files or on-demand skill loading), so delivery of the story as worded is only partial. Missing for 10: a documented skills feature or format, skill discovery/loading behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks
